s1.body: Gobaadi may collect information you provide when creating an account or using our services, including your name, phone number, email address, farm details, livestock information, location, photos, videos, and other information related to your farming activities. We may also collect information about livestock health, vaccination, feeding, treatment, marketplace listings, purchases, sales, and interactions with veterinarians or service providers. Technical information such as device type, operating system, app usage, and diagnostic data may also be collected to maintain and improve the app.
s1.heading: 1. Types of Data We Collect

s2.body: We use your information to provide, operate, maintain, and improve Gobaadi and its features. This may include managing your account, maintaining livestock records, providing reminders and personalized livestock management information, facilitating communication with veterinarians and service providers, supporting marketplace activities, processing transactions, improving our AI-powered features, and providing customer support. We may also use information to understand how users interact with the app, improve our services, prevent misuse, and maintain the security and reliability of Gobaadi.
s2.heading: 2. Use of Your Personal Data

s3.body: Gobaadi may share relevant information with veterinarians, marketplace sellers or buyers, delivery and payment service providers, technology and cloud service providers, analytics providers, and other trusted service partners when necessary to provide our services. We only share information where it is reasonably necessary for the relevant service or business purpose. We may also disclose information when required by law, legal process, or to protect the rights, safety, and security of Gobaadi, our users, livestock, or other parties. We do not sell your personal information to third parties for their independent marketing purposes.
s3.heading: 3. Disclosure of Your Personal Data

s1.body:
Gobaadi provides agricultural technology services, including AI-powered tools, animal health information, professional consultations, marketplace services, tracking, and task management.

You agree to provide accurate information and use the app only for lawful purposes.
s1.heading: 1. Use of Gobaadi

s10.body: We may update these Terms or modify, suspend, or discontinue features when necessary. We may also suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.
s10.heading: 10. Changes and Termination

s2.body:
Gobaadi may provide AI-generated animal health or agricultural information. AI results are for informational purposes only and are not a substitute for a qualified veterinarian or agricultural professional.

Gobaadi does not guarantee that AI results will always be accurate.
s2.heading: 2. AI Information

s3.body: Information or advice provided by veterinarians or other professionals is the responsibility of the respective professional. For emergencies, contact an appropriate local professional or service directly.
s3.heading: 3. Professional Consultation

s4.body:
Products and services may be provided by third-party sellers. Gobaadi does not guarantee the quality, safety, availability, or suitability of third-party products or services.

Users are responsible for reviewing product and seller information before making a purchase.
s4.heading: 4. Marketplace

s5.bullet1: Payments, cancellations, refunds, and returns are subject to the applicable transaction, seller, or Gobaadi policy.
s5.bullet2: Additional charges will be shown before applicable transactions.
s5.heading: 5. Payments and Refunds

s6.body: You are responsible for information, images, videos, and other content you submit to Gobaadi. You must have the necessary rights or permission to submit such content.
s6.heading: 6. User Content

s7.body: You must not use Gobaadi for illegal activities, fraud, harassment, unauthorized access, spreading malicious software, or activities that may harm other users or the Platform.
s7.heading: 7. Prohibited Use

s8.body: Your personal information is handled according to the Gobaadi Privacy Policy and applicable law.
s8.heading: 8. Privacy
